name: cli-chess v1.8.0
body:
- Add AppImage build status to README (thanks @ArqamQazi)
- Reduce size of AppImage by removing unnecessary packages (thanks @Samueru-sama)
- Presenter/model code cleanup
- Fix bug that misaligned containers under certain situations
- Add styling to the notation help sheet

name: cli-chess v1.7.2
body:
- Fix AppImage to remove EOL libfuse2 dependency
- Include zsync file on releases to support delta updates
- Include aarch64 AppImage build on releases

Thanks to @shuvashish76 for the AppImage request as well as providing great documentation to get this implemented.

name: cli-chess v1.7.1
body:
- Fix duplicate "Game Saved" message that appeared on game completion (#53 thanks @90Justin)
- Publish a cli-chess AppImage going forward on new releases
- General repo maintenance

name: cli-chess v1.7.0
body:
- Fix underflow boundary error that occurred on python 3.13+
- Drop support for Python 3.9 to support dependency updates (new minimum version is Python 3.10)
- Update dependency versions
- General repo maintenance

name: cli-chess v1.6.0
body:
This release comes with some great updates thanks to @twpowers and @90Justin!

- Games are now saved as PGNs after completion (https://github.com/trevorbayless/cli-chess/pull/43)
- Added a "notation cheat sheet" which can be toggled in game (https://github.com/trevorbayless/cli-chess/pull/45)
- Added the ability to send a direct challenge to a Lichess user (https://github.com/trevorbayless/cli-chess/pull/46)
- Update to have the online game clock to actually tick (https://github.com/trevorbayless/cli-chess/pull/47)

name: cli-chess v1.5.0
body:
- Remove illegal move validation checks for pre-moves to allow immediate counter attacks (https://github.com/trevorbayless/cli-chess/pull/39)
- Add the ability to chat online with your opponent (https://github.com/trevorbayless/cli-chess/pull/40)

Special thanks to @prankware-code for these contributions!

name: cli-chess v1.4.3
body: - Fixes a regression which caused the game over status to not be reported during offline games.

name: cli-chess v1.4.2
body:
- Fixed an issue causing a delay in "game over" reporting at times for offline games (related to #33)
- Adds additional logging for troubleshooting purposes (log takebacks as well as offline game ending move stack)

name: cli-chess v1.4.1
body:
- Updated cli-chess to only allow "Random" color selection for online public game seeks. This is due to Lichess removing the option to preselect a color on public seeks (PR# #15969). Players can still select a color for offline games as well as online games against the Lichess AI.
- Updated to hide board coordinates while searching for an online opponent. Board coordinates (if enabled in settings) will be displayed when an opponent is found.

name: cli-chess v1.4.0
body:
- Update to ensure online game search is cancelled if the user backs out of the search
- Add clock highlighting for online games to show whose turn it is
- Fix clock display on timeout
- Match when alerting on premove error for online/offline games
- Exception display and handling updates
- General code cleanup

name: cli-chess v1.3.0
body:
- Updated to use new Lichess TV streaming endpoint to allow for instantaneous position updates. This allows for TV streaming via cli-chess to be in sync with the Lichess TV channel
- Refactored to use EventTopics for better model notification handling
- Fixed unnecessary UI updates when playing online
- Added additional exception handling
- Dependency updates

name: cli-chess v1.2.0
body:
- Premove capability has been added for offline and online games (thanks @LKL1235!)
- Update to only show valid keybindings in the context of the game (e.g. Remove "Offer Draw" when playing against an engine)
- Bumped prompt-toolkit version to 3.0.44
- Minor code cleanup / restructure

name: cli-chess v1.1.1
body: Update to use latest `berserk` and `prompt-toolkit` versions.

name: cli-chess v1.1.0
body: Updates to allow pointing cli-chess requests to a different URL (e.g. a locally running lila instance or other development environment).

name: cli-chess v1.0.2
body: Update to fix Lichess TV streaming errors

name: cli-chess v1.0.1
body: Update to use [lichess-org berserk](https://github.com/lichess-org/berserk) instead of berserk-downstream.
